question: In Table 2, over what range was the steam mass flow rate varied in the solvent-to-feed-gas ratio study (Figure 7), and over what ratio range?
rendered: The steam mass flow rate was varied from 0.1 to 1.5 kg h−1, and the solvent-to-feed-gas ratio was varied from 1 to 4.3.
